symptoms.question: When you accelerate, do the engine revs rise but the car does not speed up accordingly? (yes/no)
Is it difficult to engage gears or do they sometimes refuse to go in? (yes/no)
Do you hear grinding noises when changing gears? (yes/no)
Does the clutch engage very high up in the pedal travel? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: Rising engine speed without matching acceleration suggests clutch slip.
rules.advice: Avoid hard acceleration and have the clutch inspected before it fails completely.

rules.diagnosis: A very high clutch biting point usually indicates a worn clutch.
rules.advice: Plan for clutch replacement, especially if there are also signs of slip or noise.

rules.diagnosis: Grinding and difficulty engaging gears suggest worn gearbox synchronisers or clutch drag.
rules.advice: Have clutch adjustment and gearbox oil checked; further diagnosis may be required.

rules.diagnosis: Difficulty engaging gears without slip can be caused by incomplete clutch disengagement.
rules.advice: Clutch hydraulics or cable may need adjustment or repair to prevent gearbox damage.
